_comment: Schema definition for Do Now question bank files. Each class has its own file named <CLASS>.json.

_questionSchema.text: string — question text as shown to students
_questionSchema.answer: string — mark-scheme answer shown on slide 2
_questionSchema.subject: Biology | Chemistry | Physics
_questionSchema.topic: string — curriculum topic tested e.g. 'Electricity — Circuits'
_questionSchema.lessonRef: string — lesson topic where this first appeared as a Do Now
_questionSchema.usedIn: string[] — lesson names where this has been used (optional, for recency tracking)

_example.answer: A section of DNA that codes for a particular characteristic.
_example.subject: Biology

_typeGuide.recall: State, Name, Give, What is — retrieval of a fact
_typeGuide.define: What is meant by, Define — requires a definition
_typeGuide.calculate: Find, Calculate, Work out — numerical answer required
_typeGuide.explain: Explain why, State one advantage — requires reasoning

_AOGuide.AO1: recall and define — knowing and understanding
_AOGuide.AO2: apply — using knowledge to calculate or explain a scenario
_AOGuide.AO3: evaluate or analyse — rarely used in Do Now
